blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — There is no doubt that panalay basketball has taken over the local basketball scene in the Philippines, at least whenever Gilas Pilipinas is not playing in a FIBA tournament. On social media, dozens of content creators produce hundreds of highlight reels featuring their favorite panalay stars performing crafty moves and acrobatic shots that have captivated thousands of basketball fans, including those outside Metro Manila. While Metro Manila remains focused on major leagues such as the PBA, UAAP, and NCAA, stepping outside the capital offers a whole new dimension of basketball through panalay leagues, also known as ligang […]...
